content.title: Chapter 46 - HOUSING — Sec. 46-47. - Rentals and tenant selection.
content.summary:
In the operation or management of housing projects, the housing authority at all times
               shall observe the duties provided in the following four sections with respect to rentals
               and tenant selection.
(Code 1981, § 14-17; Ord. No. 1248, § 8(1), 6-16-1975)
